themes.name: Concrete & Aureole
themes.description: Tadao Ando's blade of light through raw concrete — restrained mass meeting transcendent warmth, images emerging from deep shadow like devotional objects.

props.text: A blade of gold through raw concrete. The image as devotional object — held in shadow until it must be seen.

themes.name: Amber Signal
themes.description: A dawn editorial journal where warm amber ink meets deep indigo shadow — the quiet glow of a Tokyo vending machine on a rain-soaked side street, rendered in measured print hierarchy.

props.text: The vending machine hums amber through the rain. Ink finds hierarchy. Dawn finds its page.
A rain-soaked side street, measured in print.

themes.name: Iris & Gilt
themes.description: Art Nouveau poster elegance at dawn — organic botanical letterforms bloom against a misty lavender ground, gilded accents catching the first light.

body.name: IBM Plex Mono
body.stack: 'IBM Plex Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Courier New', monospace

props.text: Where botanical letterforms bloom at the gilded hour — lavender mist, bracketed links, and the weight of serif petals catching first light.

themes.name: Chalk & Voltage
themes.description: Tadao Ando's concrete spirituality meets dawn energy — raw graphite surfaces split open by a blade of golden light, where brutalist structure gives way to delicate awakening.

props.text: Concrete that breathes. A blade of gold splitting the grey — brutalism waking at dawn, voltage in the dust.

themes.name: Petal Voltage
themes.description: Dawn's soft warmth collides with electric urban intensity — blush morning mist shot through with neon magenta, like cherry blossoms lit by a vending machine glow.

body.name: IBM Plex Sans
body.stack: 'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

props.text: Cherry blossoms under neon. A vending machine at 5am. The city never softened — it just learned to blush.

themes.name: Sakura Static
themes.description: Dawn breaking over wet Tokyo streets — soft blossom pink meets electric amber, images glowing like neon through morning mist.

props.text: Dawn cracks over rain-slicked Tokyo asphalt. Blossom pink bleeds into electric amber — soft, charged, alive. This is neon through mist.

themes.name: Indigo Matins
themes.description: An Art Nouveau journal at dawn — botanical stillness rendered in muted jewel tones, where morning mist softens organic curves into legible grace.

props.text: Dawn holds its breath. Botanical forms curl at the margins of waking — muted jewels pressed between the pages of a journal no one else has opened yet.
Cormorant Garamond leads. Crimson Text follows like a whispered annotation in the margin.
